title: Misty Terrain

sections.heading: Description
lines: Misty Terrain is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as an Elemental field.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: No other Field Effect can be in place for the field to be created. If another Field Effect is present when the Misty Terrain is generated, the original Field remains active, and the Misty Terrain has fewer effects than normal. These will be highlighted by an underline.

Misty Terrain cannot be overlayed over Corrosive Mist Field, Frozen Dimensional Field or Underwater Field. If the field changes to Frozen Dimensional Field, the overlay will last until it is destroyed by a move. If the field changes to Underwater Field, the overlay will be destroyed. Misty Terrain overlay disappears if a different overlay is set while it's still active.
This field is generated by:
The ability Misty Surge on switch-in and the move Misty Terrain, for 5 turns normally and 8 turns if the Pokémon holds an Amplifield Rock.
The move Mist if used successfully and the user does not hold a working Everstone, for 3 turns normally and 6 turns if the user holds an Amplifield Rock.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Grounded Pokémon are immune to status conditions, including confusion.
“[Pokémon] is protected by the Misty Terrain!”
Fairy-type moves increase in power by 1.5x. (1.3x when overlayed)
“The Misty Terrain strengthened the attack!”
Dragon-type moves decrease in power by 0.5x.
“The Misty Terrain weakened the attack!”
Fairy-type Pokémon's Special Defense increases by 1.5x.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Marvel Scale
As of V14.0.22, the in-game battle inspection does not display the increase in defense when the field is overlayed.
Buffed Abilities:
Dry Skin heals 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.
“[Pokémon] was healed a little by the mist!”
Pastel Veil halves damage from Poison-type attacks for the user and its allies.
Pixilate increases base power by 1.5x for affected moves instead of 1.2x.
Water Compaction activates on switch-in.
Soul Heart boosts Special Defense by 1 stage on activation.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Aura Sphere, Clear Smog, Doom Desire, Hydro Steam, Icy Wind, Magical Leaf, Mist Ball, Moongeist Beam, Mystical Fire, Silver Wind, Smog, Springtide Storm, Steam Eruption, Strange Steam → 1.5x boost.
“The mist's energy strengthened the attack!”
Misty Explosion → 1.5x boost (if the user is grounded).
Inherent effect of the move.
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Dark Pulse, Night Daze, Shadow Ball → 0.5x decrease.
“The mist softened the attack...”
Explosion, Mind Blown, Self-Destruct → Fail upon use.
“The damp mist prevented the explosion...”
Other effects: Moves which are buffed:
Aqua Ring healing is doubled to 1/8 max HP per turn.
Aromatic Mist boosts the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Cosmic Power boosts the user's Defense and Special Defense by 2 stages.
Sweet Kiss' accuracy is increased to 100%.
Sweet Scent lowers the target's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Wish's healing is increased by half (75% of the target's max HP).
Field-dependent moves & abilities:
Mimicry changes the user's type to Fairy.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Fairy.
Nature Power becomes Mist Ball.
Secret Power may lower Special Attack.
Shelter halves damage from Fairy-type moves.
Terrain Pulse becomes Fairy-type.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
Any field the Misty Terrain transitions to inherits its timer.
The following moves will terminate the field: Bleakwind Storm, Defog, Gust, Hurricane, Razor Wind, Supersonic Skystrike, Tailwind, Twister, Whirlwind.
“The mist was blown away!”
This field will transform into Corrosive Mist Field if one of the moves Clear Smog, Corrosive Gas, Poison Gas or Smog is used 2 times, or the Z-Move Acid Downpour is used 1 time.
“Poison spread through the mist!”
“The mist was corroded!”
Specifically, Clear Smog, Corrosive Gas, Poison Gas and Smog increment the counter by 1, and Acid Downpour increments it by 2. The field changes to Corrosive Mist Field when the counter reaches 2.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed boosts Special Defense and applies Wish to the user.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Misty Terrain is one of the four Field Effects present in the mainline Pokémon series, although its canonical counterpart applies less effects.
